business_summary: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (NSE: HINDPETRO) is an Indian state-controlled refiner. It sits on the russian-diesel-ban chain's refinery-capacity-response link as promoter and 74% owner of HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (Pachpadra), which declared commercial operation in June 2026, the single largest addition of Indian conversion capacity inside this occurrence's window. No SEC CIK exists for this NSE-India-only listing (REQ-20260904-94/95/96 fulfilled), so all fundamentals rest on the yfinance-statements vendor block, current through FY2026 (year ended March), with all 12 canonical fields computable.
